race.description: Barry Bottams Mildura Guineas Sept 27th Pace
race.comment: FLEUR BELLA (6) finished seventh last start, beaten 9 metres at Riverina Paceway over 1740m. Finds a suitable assignment and will prove very tough to beat. MAJOR LINCOLN (9) was successful last start by 4.5 metres in a nice return to form at this track over 1790m. Draws out a little on the second line and may need luck at some point. Meeting a deeper field this time but he has the ability to mix it with them. KEAYANG CRIPPA (5) must be considered after he finished runner-up over 1790m here a week ago. Can earn some minor money again. SUNSHINE WARRIOR (10) is the best of the rest after finishing third over 2190m at this course last time out.
